description: REQ-AUTH-009 (state entropy >= 128 bits from crypto.randomBytes) is mapped in the traceability matrix (line 152) to only '(Tier 0 type guarantee + code review)'. TypeScript's type system cannot verify that a runtime call to crypto.randomBytes uses a buffer of at least 16 bytes — the return type is Buffer regardless of byte count. Code review is not a reproducible automated verification.

recommendation: Add a Tier 2 integration test PROP (required: true): 'generateSecureRandomToken returns a token with at least 128 bits of entropy (>= 32 hex chars or >= 22 base64 chars)'.
